description_excerpt: ABOUT YOUR ROLE The Manager, Apparel Innovation Enablement is responsible for creating the conditions that allow apparel innovation to move efficiently from concept to commercialization. This role focuses on establishing supplier capabilities, operating frameworks, collaboration models and commercialization pathways that enable Innovation teams, Product Creation teams and manufacturing partners to work together effectively throughout the innovation journey.
